retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast vector portrait overlaid on a split-tone photographic collage, featuring bold 1970s typography and a signature lens flare.
triggerTerms: aviator glasses graphic with lens flare
excludeWhen: modern minimalist Swiss style is requested
pastel or soft color palettes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A graphic composition featuring a large, stylized vector face with aviator sunglasses and a cigarette, bisecting a background of faded, duotone archival photographs. The color palette is a sharp diagonal split between warm red and golden yellow, tied together by heavy black ink-style outlines and a prominent white starburst lens flare on the glasses.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal color split between red (left) and yellow (right) background zones
Vector foreground elements (face, glasses, cigarette) anchored to the right
Low-opacity photographic collage integrated into the background color fields
Bold, black-on-white footer for the primary title
coreInvariants: Heavy black vector outlines for facial features
Split-tone background using only two primary hues

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The stylized face occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the forehead and chin.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, thick frames of the aviator sunglasses and the white lens flare.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the lens flare to the eyes, down the diagonal color split to the footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left red quadrant provides breathing room for secondary credits.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm Red and Golden Yellow split diagonally.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid Black for vector outlines and footer text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure White for the lens flare and footer background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background fields with high-value white highlights.

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a white horizontal bar

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and colors for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, high-impact feel of the footer.
Provides the clean, condensed verticality required for the layout.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a split-tone background divided diagonally from top-left to bottom-right. The left side is deep red, the right side is golden yellow. Overlap faded, low-opacity vintage black and white photographs into the background colors. Place a large, stylized black vector face on the right, wearing aviator sunglasses with orange-tinted lenses and a cigarette in the mouth. Add a sharp white starburst flare on the left lens. Include a solid white bar at the very bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in black, extra-condensed bold sans-serif centered in the white footer bar. Add secondary credits in white condensed bold sans-serif on the left red section, aligned left.

verificationChecks: Is the background split diagonally into red and yellow?
Is there a prominent white starburst flare on the sunglasses?
Is the footer text black on a white background?
Are the background photos low-contrast and tinted by the background colors?

adjustableVariables: Color of the sunglass lens tint
Number of points on the starburst flare
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the lens flare is pure white and sharp.
Verify the footer bar is perfectly horizontal.
Check that the vector face does not look like a specific protected individual.
Confirm the background photos are sufficiently faded to not distract from the vector art.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vector portrait + split-tone photo collage + condensed sans-serif footer = Retro Pop-Art Documentary Style
